# API2PDF

Api2Pdf is a REST API that enables developers to generate PDFs from HTML, URLs, and various document formats using engines like wkhtmltopdf, Headless Chrome, and LibreOffice.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/api2pdf/.

## Actions

- **Add Header Footer**: Add headers and footers to a pdf document.
- **Delete PDF**: Delete a previously generated pdf.
- **Extract PDF Pages**: Extract specific pages from a pdf document.
- **Generate Barcode or QR Code**: Generate barcodes or qr codes using zebra crossing (zxing).
- **LibreOffice PDF to HTML**: Convert a pdf document to html using libreoffice.
- **LibreOffice Thumbnail**: Generate a thumbnail image of a document using libreoffice.
- **Merge PDFs**: Merge multiple pdf documents into a single pdf.
- **Optimize PDF**: Optimize a pdf document to reduce file size while maintaining quality.
- **Reorder PDF Pages**: Reorder pages of a pdf document.
